The fwooa bean bag combines doob’s love for versatile designs, with a comfy and stretch fabric, and a curvy aesthetic. Sitting on the fwooa will make you go “FWOOA” as you recline in comfort and the fwooarmrest lets you use whatever device you fancy while you alleviate any wrist or forearm strain.

• Super versatile
• Stretchy and strong STREXX™ cover
• Use fwooarmrest on bed or sofa, as an armrest or even a maternity pillow
• Removable outer cover
• Filled with smoovflux™ fine pellets for a smoother experience
• Child-safe zip for inner bag
• Protected by Speco®
• Made in Singapore

Material: STREXX™(polyester, spandex blend) cover; Spandex inner bag
Cleaning: Machine wash in cold water. Wash separately. Line dry.

The all new fwoomp bean bag in a fusion of fabrics - a stretchy seating area, contained by a durable frame that creates a one-of-a-kind seating experience. Under the fwoompy hood is an elastic and durable inner bag - the famous dooble™ layer - which means your doob bean bag is more durable, safer, and easier to clean. The filled option comes with smoovflux™, which makes the fwoomp smoother to the touch.  

• Stretchy STREXX™ fabric seat for greater comfort
• Durable DRYXX™ fabric frame for support
• Removable outer cover
• Filled with smoovflux™ fine pellets for a smoother experience
• Child-safe zip for inner bag
• Protected by Speco®
• Made in Singapore

Material: DRYXX™ (polyester and polyurethane composite) and STREXX™(polyester, spandex blend) cover; Spandex inner bag
Cleaning: Hand wash or rinse. DRYXX portion can be wiped with damp cloth.

The Senchaise is a chair you take refuge in, from the stresses and anxieties of modern living. Designed using principles from pressure and sensory therapy, the Senchaise promotes the production of hormones that are linked to mental health and wellbeing. Sink into the Senchaise for twenty minutes or more to help wind down. 

Unlike bulky therapy devices, the Senchaise is designed to be furniture, to fit into your home without sticking out or taking up precious space. 

• Suspension Design, Weighted Flaps
• Floating Design, Versatile Usage
• Gentle Design, All-round comfort
• Simple Design - no mechanical or electronic parts
• Smooth Texture
• Double-layered
• Made in Singapore
